installCommand: if [ -f webscraper/package.json ]; then export PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1; (cd webscraper && npm ci); (cd app && npm ci); npm ci; else echo 'Static site, skipping npm'; fi
buildCommand: if [ -f scripts/assemble-site.mjs ]; then node scripts/assemble-site.mjs; else mkdir -p site && cp index.html site/ && { cp styles.css app.js site/ || true; }; fi
